title: "V2001 type_mismatch"
description: "An expression has a different type from the one its context requires."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2001` prints this explanation offline.

An expression has a different type from the one its context requires. `expected` and `actual`
carry both types.

Wrong:

```sakura
fn double(x: Int) -> Int { x * 2.0 }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn double(x: Int) -> Int { x * 2 }
```
